title: Exponential bound for a linear-form tail moment
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ be real coefficients satisfying $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2=1$. For every real $s\geq1$, if $X$ is uniform on the sign cube and $L(X)=\sum_{i=1}^n a_iX_i$, then $\mathbb{E}\bigl[|L(X)|\,\mathbf{1}_{\{s<|L(X)|\}}\bigr]\leq(2s+2)\exp(-s^2/2)$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real coefficient vector indexed by $1,\ldots,n$
